title: Death to px, long live ch
summary: A blog post advocating for using CSS 'ch' units (character width) instead of 'px' pixels for better responsive and accessible web design. The author argues that character-based measurements adapt better to different font sizes and user preferences.
problem_solved: Provides an alternative to fixed pixel measurements that doesn't scale well with user font preferences.
why_valuable: ch units create layouts that naturally adapt to text size, improving both responsiveness and accessibility.
